test_output_summary: All 36 tests passed (12 config tests, 9 error tests, 15 utils tests from existing code). Tests cover: default construction, env overrides, boolean flag validation with clear error messages, import-time env isolation (SR-03), exception constructors and messages, HTTP type isolation, hermetic env pinning.
implementation_notes: Implemented VoiceConfig as a frozen dataclass with from_env() classmethod that mirrors HTTPAuthConfig pattern. Created six exception classes (VoiceError base + RecordingTooLarge, QueryTooLong, UnsupportedAudioFormat, EmptyRecording, UnintelligibleQuery, VoiceUnavailable) with specified constructors and messages. All exceptions are plain Python exceptions, not HTTP types. UnsupportedAudioFormat includes sorted supported types in error message. Boolean parsing uses _parse_bool_flag function with clear ValueError on invalid input. No os.environ access at import time - all env reads happen in from_env() call. Tests follow hermetic-env discipline with full env-var pinning.

completion_promises.criterion_text: VoiceConfig.from_env() returns a frozen instance; defaults above; malformed boolean raises ValueError naming the variable
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented VoiceConfig as @dataclass(frozen=True) with from_env() classmethod. All defaults match specification: enabled=False, stt_base_url='http://promaxgb10-41b1:9000/v1', stt_model='parakeet-tdt', tts_base_url='http://promaxgb10-41b1:9000/v1', tts_model='qwen3-tts', tts_voice='Ryan', plus constants for audio_timeout_seconds=10.0, max_query_seconds=60, max_recording_bytes=10MB, chunk_ttl_seconds=120, and supported_base_mimetypes set. Boolean parsing via _parse_bool_flag raises ValueError on invalid input with message: 'Failed to parse STUDY_TUTOR_VOICE_ENABLED: Invalid boolean value ...' which names the variable.

completion_promises.criterion_text: No os.environ access at import time (SR-03 discipline)
completion_promises.evidence: Config module has no module-level os.environ access. All environment variable reading happens inside from_env() classmethod which accepts env values as parameters. Test test_no_import_time_env_access verifies this by setting env vars, reloading the module, and confirming that creating a config without passing values returns defaults (not the env values), proving no import-time env access occurred.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Six exception classes exist with the constructors/messages above; none subclass Starlette/HTTP types
completion_promises.evidence: Created six exception classes in voice/errors.py: VoiceError (base), RecordingTooLarge(max_bytes), QueryTooLong(max_seconds), UnsupportedAudioFormat(received_mimetype, supported), EmptyRecording(), UnintelligibleQuery(), and VoiceUnavailable(message='Voice services are temporarily unavailable'). All inherit from VoiceError which inherits from Exception. None subclass Starlette's HTTPException. Test test_exceptions_do_not_subclass_http_types verifies this with issubclass checks against starlette.exceptions.HTTPException.
